notes: v3.0.79 - Full Visit Notes OFF is now truly schedule-only for bulk day, month, and year pulls: MLS reads appointment rows and does not open patient charts or historical visit bodies. Full Visit Notes ON remains the explicit opt-in for full chart history. First sign-in requires a clear choice and keeps bulk pulls blocked until it is made. Pulls now end with durable complete, partial, or failed receipts and clearer retry details. Copilot uses minimum-necessary active-patient context and can answer supported longitudinal visit and procedure questions. Supervised review now generates HPI, ROS, Physical Exam, Assessment, and Plan as separate drafts, shows exactly where each will go, and inserts a clinician-confirmed draft only into its exact verified Athena section; MLS reads it back as unsaved and never saves or signs automatically. Narrative medical-legal reports now follow the supplied physician-report structure with concrete source gaps and grounded opinion sections. Athena keep-alive pauses during active pulls. Everything from earlier releases remains. Requires Chrome 116+.
